prompt_text:
Task: General Text Translation

Write code that translates HTML or markup while preserving tags using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Machine Translation:
  Service: Machine Translation
  SDK: alibabacloud_alimt
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: TranslateGeneral, GetTranslateReport
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/machine-translation

Option 2 — DeepL:
  Service: DeepL API
  SDK: deepl
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: translate_text
  Setup hints: DEEPL_AUTH_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepl.com/docs/api-reference/translate

Option 3 — Google Cloud Translation:
  Service: Cloud Translation
  SDK: google-cloud-translate
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: translate_text, batch_translate_text
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/overview

Option 4 — Azure AI Translator:
  Service: Azure AI Translator
  SDK: azure-ai-translation-text / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: translate
  Setup hints: AZURE_TRANSLATOR_KEY, AZURE_TRANSLATOR_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/

Option 5 — Amazon Translate:
  Service: Amazon Translate
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: translate_text, translate_document
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/what-is.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

```python import os from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate def translate_html_preserve_tags(html_content, target_language): """ Translates HTML content while preserving tags using Google Cloud Translation. Args: html_content (str): The HTML content to translate target_language (str): The target language code (e.g., 'es', 'fr') Returns: str: The translated HTML content """ # Initialize the Google Cloud Translation client translate_client = translate.Client() # Extract text content and track tag positions # This is a simplified approach - in practice, you'd want a more robust HTML parser text_parts = [] tag_stack = [] current_text = "" i = 0 while i < len(html_content): if html_content[i] == '<': # Save accumulated text if current_text: text_parts.append(('text', current_text)) current_text = "" # Find the end of the tag end_tag = html_content.find('>', i) if end_tag != -1: tag = html_content[i:end_tag+1] text_parts.append(('tag', tag)) i = end_tag else: current_text += html_content[i] i += 1 # Add remaining text if current_text: text_parts.append(('text', current_text)) # Extract all text parts for translation texts_to_translate = [part[1] for part in text_parts if part[0] == 'text'] # Translate text parts translated_texts = [] if texts_to_translate: results = translate_client.translate( texts_to_translate, target_language=target_language, format_='html' ) translated_texts = [result['translatedText'] for result in results] # Rebuild HTML with translated text output = [] text_index = 0 for part_type, content in text_parts: if part_type == 'text': if text_index < len(translated_texts): output.append(translated_texts[text_index]) text_index += 1 else: output.append(content) return ''.join(output) # Example usage: # translated_html = translate_html_preserve_tags("

Hello world

", "es") # print(translated_html) ```
